notes.title: Voiceover Update and Bug Fixes
notes.content: [p]A big hello from Valendor! Today I'm rolling out an update that’s large in size but not in the number of fixes: you can now choose between narrated and machine voiceover for quests and events in both the English and Russian versions. Please note that the second chapter hasn’t yet been recorded by the narrator, but I’ll be uploading this update later this week.[/p][p]I’ve also fixed a bug that prevented achievements from being awarded. This week I’ll announce the exact release date for Act III, it will definitely come out in September, but there’s still plenty of cleanup to do with errors and bugs.[/p]

notes.title: Support for widescreen displays

Added support for widescreen displays.

[list]
[*] Quest balance.

[/list]

With widescreen monitor support, there are minor lags in the throne room when loading the next map size, which do not affect gameplay. They will be fixed in the next update.

notes.title: Critical error after yesterday's update.
notes.content: [p]After yesterday’s addition of several effects, a bug may (or may not) occur when winter begins — the map remains in its autumn state. There’s also an issue with the generation of certain quests between turns 26 and 30. I’m currently fixing these bugs, which I didn’t catch during the build testing. A new build will be published tonight.[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Act II is almost here: return to Valendor on May 31st!
notes.content:
You’ve been away from the throne for a while, but the kingdom needs you once again. A harsh winter has brought suffering and strife, and your southern neighbor is sharpening swords and stringing bows — war is looming.
Can you emerge victorious in the upcoming battle? Or perhaps avoid it altogether?
It all depends on your choices and... the will of Lumen.

[list]
[*] You’ll reunite with familiar faces: the enigmatic Alestra, the cunning Troy, the reckless adventurer Filler Brashbill, the poet-baron I’Vald, the insufferable diplomat Cardos Mirvald Zutaba Artarion, and all the faction leaders.
[*] Over 200 new quests and events.
[*] A chance to avoid war and trigger a completely alternate storyline.
[*] More than 6 distinct paths to victory in the war.
[*] And, of course, two dozen new ways to die.
[/list]

With the release of Act II, prices in some regions will increase by 10-15%. Get it now at the current price!

notes.content:

2. Bonus effect for easy and normal difficulty levels when starting a new game. The effectiveness of the buff depends on the number of deaths experienced.
